correctness.rationale: For each fixed 0<theta<pi, Lu–Zu Theorem 3.4 supplies a core spectrum consisting of 1 and the signed pairs ±|alpha_n|; multiplicity two is necessary. The two-point Fisher–Hartwig OPUC expansion at distinct unit roots supplies alpha_n=2cos((n+3)theta)/n+O_theta(n^-2), with theta fixed. For t→0, discard n<t^(-3/4) (o(1/t) terms) and bound the remaining coefficient error by O(t^(3/2))=o(t); equidistribution of irrational rotations or exact finite rational orbits then yields t*N_C(t)→4*mean|cos|. Positive counting coefficient plus monotone inversion gives N*s_N→Lambda rather than merely a logarithmic Cesàro result. The exact cosine averages give irrational 8/pi, rational odd q 4 csc(pi/(2q))/q and even q 4 cot(pi/(2q))/q, with sharp bounds 2 and 8/3, extremizers q=2 and q=3. This is fixed-angle only, excludes root coalescence theta=0,pi, and does not claim a quantified rate. Independently reconstructed Toeplitz moment solves at 20 (angle,index) pairs checked the oscillatory phase; those checks cannot prove the infinite asymptotic.
